parakeet: What's up, family? Here is an unpopular opinion. Teachers are nice to have, but they are not necessary for the educational process. They are complementary to the educational process. I think it's important to make this distinction because when we don't, you raise generations of people who position themselves in the reasoning of they didn't teach as opposed to I didn't learn. And while yes, while teachers are not necessary for the educational process, learners absolutely are. Just something to think about.
